name: Gito
description: Stateless AI code reviewer that checks pull requests or local changes with any LLM provider and runs easily in CI.
whatItDoes: Gito finds problems in code changes and reports them, either on your machine or as comments on a pull request. It keeps no server-side state, so it fits into existing CI pipelines. It is for teams that want vendor-neutral automated review.
howItWorks: A setup command stores the model configuration, then the review command analyses the diff and writes a report. In CI the report can be published as a pull request comment using a platform token. The model provider is freely selectable.

requirements.name: LLM_API_KEY
requirements.description: Model key used in CI workflows

requirements.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
requirements.description: Needed to post review comments on GitHub
